  $$(d) Total in all three subjects \ge  220 OR Total in Java and C++ \ge  150$$  
  If the aggregate mark of an eligible candidate is more than 240, he will be eligible for a  
  scholarship course, otherwise he will be eligible for normal course.  
  The program reads the marks in the three subjects and generates the following outputs:  
  (i) Not eligible  
  (ii) Eligible for scholarship course  
  (iii) Eligible for normal course  
  Design test cases for this program using decision table testing.

  R: The program should print biggest of 3 numbers a,b,c. If the numbers are equal, it  
  A)         should print the first number in the sequence to be the biggest.  
  
  P:  
  void CompareThreeNos( )  
  { int a,b,c; input( a,b,c);  
  $$if((a>=b) and (a< =c))$$  
  { print( a is biggest);}  
  $$else if((b>=a) and (b>=c))                                                                    (5)$$  
  { print( b is biggest);}  
  else{ print( c is biggest);}  
  }  
  
  TC# a b c Exp O/P

  M: Logical AND Operator is changed to OR.  
  
  B)         Consider a three-input program to handle personal loans of a customer. Its input is a  
  triple of positive integers (say principal, rate and term).  
  $$1000 < = principal < =40000$$  
  $$1< =rate< =18$$  
  $$1< =term< = 6$$  
  The program should calculate the interest for the whole term of the loan and the total  
  amount of the personal loan.                                                                  (5)  
  The output is:  
  $$interest = principal * (rate/100) * term$$  
  $$total_amount = principal + interest$$  
  
  Generate normal and robust boundary value test cases.
